split_status: prospective_campaign_split; entity/template overlap and class support not yet audited
current_reads: inventory plus development scenario members only; reserved final member bodies and labels stay unread before candidate freeze
raw_label_contract: Use publisher per-line annotations only with the exact corresponding source file, original line numbers and simulation-time bounds. Never infer normal from a missing label file.
alert_label_contract: Attack-phase time intervals are not automatically exact per-alert malicious labels; audit attribution and ambiguity before any binary score.
inference_input_exclusions: source member path as a class feature
absolute event time as a class shortcut
raw user/host/IP identifiers as memorization features
missing_claim_policy: No manufactured healthy device posture, managed flag, active identity, MFA, resource role or business approval. Unknown remains unknown.
denominator_policy: Declare source scope before inference. Keep known-label parse errors, inference errors and abstentions in the evaluation population; no model-error-based filtering.
permitted_use: Raw LDS CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0: noncommercial research/evaluation only. ADS CC-BY-4.0: preserve attribution. No automatic production artifact adoption.
operational_scope: historical publisher testbed data, not live authenticated IdP/EDR signals or organization-approved business jobs
independent_human_review: not assigned; no reviewer identity or approval fabricated
